chunks: My father (may Allah have mercy on him) narrated to me from Sa'd ibn 'Abdillah, from al-Hasan ibn Musa, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Isma'il ibn Jabir, from Abu 'Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Al-Husayn (peace be upon him) said: 'I am the Martyr of Tears.'

key_terms.الْعَبْرَة: Tears; specifically the tears of grief and mourning
key_terms.قَتِيلُ الْعَبْرَةِ: Martyr of Tears; a title for Imam Husayn indicating his death causes continuous weeping among believers

ai.seo_question: What does the title 'Martyr of Tears' signify regarding Imam Husayn?
ai.summary: In Kamil al-Ziyarat, Ibn Qulawayh records Imam al-Sadiq (a.s.) narrating that Imam al-Husayn (a.s.) identified himself as 'Qatil al-'Abrah' (the Martyr of Tears), a title emphasizing the emotional resonance of his sacrifice. This designation underscores the Shia theological view that his martyrdom serves as a perpetual source of spiritual awakening and communal cohesion, ensuring that remembrance of him inevitably evokes tears and deepens faith.
